text.tspan: Now the church life is all one piece
The Church — As Our Home and Rest
Children are the Lord’s heritage, so dear in God’s eyes!
Just like arrows in quiver aimed for Satan’s demise!
Even though they might trouble us and vex our soul,
We must learn to recover them and not let them go!
Lord, we thank You for all the ones You’ve placed here with us
To express You and represent You—how glorious!
Chosen vessels, containers to be filled with You;
Let’s keep fighting, dispensing with God’s purpose in view!
